title: seed: a composite externalId that includes a reference only fillable after the first load never matches on later loads, so each load inserts another row
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPJxG4vBVaLCBWLcWJ

Filing gate ①: class a (reproduced), an out-of-scope finding of the #34613 card thread (PR #34791), passed on by area `o2-A` on the seat's word. Not fixed there; that PR does not change composite-key matching.

Suggested-grade: p2 · class a (reproduced) · seed loader composite-key matching (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`)

## 维护者速读

- 现象：种子数据集用复合 `externalId`,而其中一个键字段是首次加载时只能留空的引用(例如还没注册的人员)。之后每次加载时该引用已能解析，复合键与首次落库的那行不再相同，于是匹配不上、再插一行。
- 影响范围:#34613 退役 insert/replace 后，作者被引导改用默认模式 + 复合 externalId,这条路径会变得更常见。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Evidence (measured on the #34613 branch)

Three boots over one database file: a dataset whose composite `externalId` includes a person reference that is NULL on the first load. Rows: 1 → 2 → 3. Composite matching is unchanged by PR #34791.

## Seam

How the loader builds the composite key on replay: it resolves references before matching, so the replay's key carries the now-resolved value while the stored row still holds NULL. Whether the fix is matching on the key as first landed (the landed-key ledger), refusing a composite key over a deferred reference at authoring time, or something else is the claiming seat's call.

## Dedupe words

`seed composite externalId deferred reference`, `seed replay composite key null reference duplicate`

Related: #34613 (ruling 6942780880), #34542 (held person references across restarts).
